report:
> MRI of knee was performed in sagittal, axial and coronal sections.
> Spin echo sequence were used.

> There are linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Lateral meniscus appears to be normal.
> The contour of ACL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 2 injury.
> Increased infiltration surround medial collateral ligament, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> The contour of PCL and lateral collateral ligametn appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Abnormal signal intensity is noted in posterior aspect of distal femur, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae.
> Subcutaneous infiltration around knee
> Mild irregular thining of the articular cartilage, maybe indicate mild osteoarthritis.

Impression: 
1. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
2. Bone contusion at posterior aspect of bilateral femoral condyle.
3. In favor of grade 2 injury of anterior cruciate ligament; grade 1 injury of medial collateral ligament.
4. C/W mild osteoarthritis.
5. Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis.

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Verdicktes MPFL mit angrenzend diffusen Suszeptibilitäten. Keine Ruptur.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Aus der CT-Untersuchung vom [DATE] bekannte Impression des lateralen Femurkondylus. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Bone-bruise am anteroinferioren Patellarand. Obergflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten retropatellär an der medialen Patellafacette. Ansonsten intakter Knorpel. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.
Der Sulcus-Winkel beträgt 151°. Grenzwertige Patella alta bei einem canton-Deschaumps-Index von 1,3, Patellaform Wiberg Typ III.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Ausgedehnter Liphämarthros. 4 x 8 x 14 mm messender freier Gelenkkörper im ventralen gelenkrezessus oberhalb der Eminentina intercondylaris.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir.  Medial menisküs arka boynuzunda grade II dejenerasyon mevcuttur.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Diz ekleminde ve suprapatellar bursada hafif dereceli efüzyon izlenmektedir. Femur medial kondil anterolateralinde tibia lateral plato anteriorunda medial eminens düzeyine doğru uzanan kontüzyon ile uyumlu kemik iliği sinyal değişiklikleri dikkati çekmiştir.

In the medial compartment, there is buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus, at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn. There is displaced meniscal fragment into the intercondylar notch. The articular cartilage appears normal.  
  
 The lateral compartment, the lateral meniscus is not torn. he articular cartilage appears normal.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is acute complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior tibial translation. 
  
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Large amount of right knee effusion with hemarthrosis is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  
 There is bone bruise at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle.   Buckethandle tear of the medial meniscus. 
  Acute complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
  Grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament. 
  Large amount of right knee effusion with hemarthrosis. 
  Bone bruise at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle.

Findings:  There is a moderate knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  ACL is ruptured. There is anterior translation of the lateral tibial plateau in relation to femur. Bone contusions are seen in the weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and posterior aspect of the tibia.  Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Normal tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Moderate effusion. ACL rupture. No meniscal tear

There is a moderate knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  ACL is ruptured in its mid substance. There is mild anterior translation of the lateral tibial plateau in relation to femur. Bone contusions are noted in the posterior aspects of the medial and lateral tibial condyle. Small contusions are seen in the peripheral aspect of the weightbearing femoral condyle. A moderate contusion is also seen in the inferior pole of patella.  Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal. Normal remaining visualized bones. Normal surrounding soft tissues.  
Conclusion: ACL rupture with associated moderate knee effusion and bone contusions.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Geringe oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten an der medialen Femurcondyle (Serie 4/ Image 20). Intakter Innenmeniskus. Bei subtotaler Ruptur des MCL im Vergleich zur Voruntersuchung insbesondere in den tiefen Anteilen deutlich verbreitertes und aufgefasertes MCL mit verbliebenen Signalalterationen. Mitbeteiligung des POL im superfiziellen Bandanteil.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Deutliches bone-bruise im posterolateralen Tibiaplateau bei hier stattgehabter Infraktion mit chondraler, intraartikulärer Beteiligung (Serie 5/ Image 24). Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Regelrechte Darstellung der Patellar- und Quadrizepssehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Ruptur des VKB mit partiell umgeschlagenem distalen Bandstumpf auf die Außenmeniskusvorderhornwurzel (Serie 4/ Image 17). 
Einige Fasern des posterolateralen Bündels frgl. narbig durchziehend imponierend (4/19-21). Intaktes HKB.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
